hooks.command: sh -c 'a=; w=$(/bin/pwd -P 2>/dev/null || pwd -P) || w=; r=$PATH:; while [ -n "$r" ]; do d=${r%%:*}; r=${r#*:}; case $d in /*) ;; *) continue;; esac; f=$d/alalanet-agent; [ -f "$f" ] && [ -x "$f" ] || continue; k=0; while [ -L "$f" ] && [ $k -lt 40 ]; do l=$(readlink "$f") || break; case $l in /*) f=$l;; *) f=${f%/*}/$l;; esac; k=$((k+1)); done; [ -L "$f" ] && continue; [ -f "$f" ] && [ -x "$f" ] || continue; p=${f%/*}; p=$(CDPATH="" cd -P -- "${p:-/}" 2>/dev/null && { /bin/pwd -P 2>/dev/null || pwd -P; }) || continue; case $p/ in "${w%/}"/*) continue;; esac; a=$p/${f##*/}; break; done; if [ -n "$a" ]; then exec "$a" hook codex; fi; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"alalanet guard: no executable alalanet-agent in an absolute PATH folder outside the workspace, so this command was NOT checked. Install it from https://alalanet.com/dl and put it on PATH.\"}"'
hooks.commandWindows: set NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1& "%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$w = $env:OS -eq 'Windows_NT'; $n = if ($w) { 'alalanet-agent.exe' } else { 'alalanet-agent' }; $abs = if ($w) { '^([A-Za-z]:[\\/]|[\\/]{2})' } else { '^/' }; $cmp = if ($w) { [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase } else { [StringComparison]::Ordinal }; $s = [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar; $c = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).ProviderPath).TrimEnd('\', '/') + $s; function U($x) { ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($x).TrimEnd('\', '/') + $s).StartsWith($c, $cmp) }; foreach ($d in ($env:PATH -split [IO.Path]::PathSeparator)) { if (($d -match $abs) -and -not (U $d)) { $p = Join-Path $d $n; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { $t = $p; $ok = $true; for ($k = 0; $k -lt 40; $k++) { $i = Get-Item -LiteralPath $t -Force; if (-not $i.LinkType) { break }; $g = @($i.Target)[0]; if (-not $g) { $ok = $false; break }; $t = if ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($g)) { $g } else { Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $t) $g } }; if ($ok -and ($k -lt 40) -and -not (U $t)) { $m = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $t -Force).UnixMode; if ($w -or -not $m -or $m -cmatch '[xst]') { $global:LASTEXITCODE = $null; try { & $t hook codex } catch { }; if ($null -ne $LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } } } } }; @{systemMessage='alalanet guard: no executable alalanet-agent in an absolute PATH folder outside the workspace, so this command was NOT checked. Install it from https://alalanet.com/dl and put it on PATH.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0"
